definitions.explanation: Human emotions, particularly feelings of affection, sympathy, or passion.
Feelings of caring and concern for others.

examples.japanese: {情|じょう}に{厚|あつ}い{人|ひと}だ。
{情|じょう}に{流|なが}されてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't be swayed by emotions.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{一緒|いっしょ}にいると{情|じょう}が{移|うつ}る。
examples.english: When you're together for many years, you develop feelings of attachment.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}は{人間|にんげん}の{情|じょう}を{深|ふか}く{描|えが}いていて、{涙|なみだ}が{止|と}まらなかった。
examples.english: That movie depicted human emotions so deeply that I couldn't stop crying.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{情|じょう}が{深|ふか}く、{困|こま}っている{人|ひと}を{見|み}ると{放|ほう}っておけない。
examples.english: He is deeply compassionate and can't leave someone in trouble alone.

examples.japanese: {情|じょう}にもろい{性格|せいかく}だから、つらい{話|はなし}を{聞|き}くとすぐ{泣|な}いてしまう。
examples.english: I have a soft-hearted nature, so I cry easily when I hear sad stories.

notes:
{情|じょう} refers to deep feelings, especially emotional bonds and compassion.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {情|じょう}に{厚|あつ}い (warm-hearted, compassionate)
- {情|じょう}に{流|なが}される (to be swayed by emotion)
- {情|じょう}が{移|うつ}る (to develop emotional attachment)
- {情|じょう}が{深|ふか}い (deeply emotional, affectionate)
- {情|じょう}け{容赦|ようしゃ}なく (mercilessly)

COMPOUNDS:
- {感情|かんじょう} (emotion, feeling)
- {友情|ゆうじょう} (friendship)
- {愛情|あいじょう} (love, affection)
- {同情|どうじょう} (sympathy)
- {情報|じょうほう} (information)
